name: Angkor Empire Marathon 2027
short_description: The Angkor Empire Marathon returns to Siem Reap on Sunday 8 August 2027, running past the temples of Angkor over distances up to the full marathon.
ai_summary: The Angkor Empire Marathon is scheduled for Sunday 8 August 2027 in Siem Reap, Cambodia. It is run through the Angkor Archaeological Park, with earlier editions starting in front of Angkor Wat itself, and is AIMS-sanctioned. The full marathon is the headline distance, with a half marathon, 10 km and 3 km alongside it. Distances are those of the most recent edition; the 2027 line-up has not been published yet. The AIMS listing gives the organiser's address in Phnom Penh; the race itself is held at Angkor, near Siem Reap.

core_facts.venue: In front of Angkor Wat Temple, Siem Reap

faqs.question: When is the Angkor Empire Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Sunday 8 August 2027, at Angkor near Siem Reap in Cambodia. It is one of two AIMS-sanctioned races held at Angkor, the other being the Angkor Wat International Half Marathon, which runs in December.

faqs.question: What distances does the Angkor Empire Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: The full 42.195 km marathon is the headline event, with a half marathon, a 10 km and a 3 km run alongside it. These are the distances from the most recent edition; the 2027 categories, start times and entry fees are not yet published.
